profile.headline: Software Engineer at The New York Times
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
👋🏽 Hi! I'm Noah, a UC Berkeley alum with a degree in Data Science, focusing on Human & Population Health. I'm currently a software engineer at the New York Times building multimodal news experiences in audio and video.

I have a strong background in full-stack and data engineering including a previous experience at Squarespace where I contributed to building a new, native payments system for business owners. 

Outside of my career & coursework, I love working with nonprofits to help empower communities and drive positive change. 

Let's chat about ways we can make our communities more accessible!

positions.description:
Worked on various data pipelines serving analytics & other business teams across data domains including subscription, user behavior, and revenue data within the Analytics Data Products team.

Designed and developed a system to standardize core business metrics and dimensions across analytical, experimentation, and advertising use cases.

positions.title: VP of Technology
positions.description: Responsible for onboarding our new developers with Blueprint's tech stack of React, Typescript, and Supabase. Providing technical support and product guidance for our five projects while maintaining Blueprint's technology infrastructure

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Working with a team of 6 to build a mobile-friendly web application for Peninsula Humane Society & SPCA, a nonprofit organization focused on improving animal welfare in the Bay Area.

positions.title: Project Lead
positions.description: Leading a team to develop a mobile application for Voucher 4 Veggies, a San Francisco-based nonprofit  working to improve food security in low-income households

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Working in a team of 7 to develop a mobile app and web dashboard for SIREN, a nonprofit which provides pro-bono immigrant legal services.

positions.title: External Director
positions.description:
Promoting and expanding social good in tech to the community beyond our organization and non-profits.

Fall 2020:
Created a more centralized resource database for other Blueprint Chapters and aspiring Chapters. 

Spring 2021:
Set the foundation for bloom, a mentorship program between industry professionals and college students.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Life Rolls On is a nonprofit organization with the goal of promoting a healthy lifestyle in the adaptive community through surf and skate events.

Land Leader: Maintain a line of communication between land and water volunteers. Help organize and establish roles for other volunteers in order to best accommodate adaptive athletes

Water Volunteer: Brought athletes out to water, and assisted them with surfing. Coordinated with other water volunteers to establish an efficient routine for our time with the athlete.
Assist the organization's head of merchandise to keep track of sales and inventory.

volunteerExperience.description:
Life Rolls On is a nonprofit organization with the goal of promoting a healthy lifestyle in the adaptive community through surf and skate events.

Land Leader: Maintain a line of communication between land and water volunteers. Help organize and establish roles for other volunteers in order to best accommodate adaptive athletes

Water Volunteer: Brought athletes out to water, and assisted them with surfing. Coordinated with other water volunteers to establish an efficient routine for our time with the athlete.
Assist the organization's head of merchandise to keep track of sales and inventory.
